target: AArch64 PCI QEMU, cooperative host task bridge
result: pass: TaskMessageSchedulingChecks returned 0x2a after the compiler reset
evidence: A task that only polls MessageScan, KeyScan, CharScan, and FlushMessages kept the CPU and the peer did not run. Explicit Yield and a blocked MessageGet did hand off to the next ready task. This confirms that message scanning itself does not switch tasks in the host task bridge.
limitations: This is a focused PCI QEMU regression for the cooperative host task bridge. It does not establish that pinned Kernel/Sched.ZC is active, that the guest uses the full ZealOS scheduler, or that the live UTM/Pi X-Caliber input behavior has changed.
